title: Kubernetes 投影 token：輪替、重讀與殘留期限
titleEn: Kubernetes projected tokens: rotation, rereading and stale lifetimes
subcategoryTitle: 工作負載身分與聯邦信任驗證
summary: 以合成t0、expiry、檔案更新與應用重讀事件建立時間線；區分token audience與Pod綁定，不把此練習套用到永久Secret token。
summaryEn: Build a synthetic timeline of issuance, expiry, file replacement and application rereading. Record audience and Pod binding separately, and do not apply this exercise to long-lived Secret-based tokens.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 401可能是應用快取舊token，或使用新token但受眾不符；僅看到投影檔案存在不能排除任何一種。
採可觀測的定期重讀或SDK更新機制，並保留有界重試；禁止把投影token複製成永久憑證以規避輪替。
Kubernetes投影service-account token由kubelet輪替；應用仍需讀取更新後的token。本課研究檔案已更新但程序仍快取舊值的落差。
optionsEn: An authentication rejection may reflect a cached old token or a fresh token with the wrong audience. The existence of the projected file excludes neither explanation.
Use observable periodic rereading or an appropriate SDK refresh mechanism with bounded retries. Do not turn a projected token into a permanent copied credential merely to avoid handling rotation.

steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. An authentication rejection may reflect a cached old token or a fresh token with the wrong audience. The existence of the projected file excludes neither explanation.

knowledge.text: 在本課短TTL情境，80%TTL輪替觸發早於24小時條件；以到期減觸發與重讀延遲估算餘裕。觸發時刻不是保證完成時刻。
knowledge.textEn: For the short TTL used here, the 80%-of-TTL trigger precedes the 24-hour condition. Estimate margin by subtracting trigger time and reread delay from expiry; a trigger is not a guarantee of completed renewal.
